description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'GatewaySession' and associated data structures for managing WebSocket connections with a gateway server, handling connection setup, message processing, request/response handling, and reconnection logic in an Android environment. It appears to be integral to the client-side communication layer of an Android app in a networked system.

classes.name: GatewaySession
classes.description: Manages WebSocket connections to a gateway server, including connection setup, message handling, and reconnection strategies. Provides functions for sending events, requesting data, and handling responses.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Starts a connection to the specified gateway endpoint with provided authentication options.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Terminates the current connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: reconnect
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect by closing the current connection and initiating a new one.

methods.name: sendNodeEvent
methods.description: Sends a node event with a payload JSON to the connected server.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs a request to the server with specified method and parameters, returning the response payload.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability
methods.description: Refreshes the node's canvas capability URL from the server.
